title: JAX: Composable Transformations of NumPy Programs
description: JAX treats neural network computation as pure functional transformations — `grad`, `jit`, `vmap`, `pmap` compose freely. This enables writing research code that compiles to XLA and runs identically on CPU/GPU/TPU. It is Google's primary research framework for Gemini, Gemma, and AlphaFold.
authors: Bradbury, Frostig, Hawkins, Johnson, Leary, Maclaurin, Necula, Paszke, VanderPlas, Zhang (Google)
